title: ウララ的トレーニング

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to think of a plan to get her to focus. One day, I spot Haru Urara joyfully helping out the shopkeepers of the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara talks about how much she loves to help others. Hearing that, I devise a training program that also acts as a way to help the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And to keep her interested, I don't call it training, but refer to it as a series of contests. The plan is foolproof.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My idea succeeds at getting Haru Urara to train hard.
